assertion: A preserve-3d scene establishes an isolated stacking context. Its blending planes see the scene background and previously painted planes, not the page outside it. The two-plane overlap is blue; a transparent scene keeps cyan instead of multiplying it by the yellow page.

browser.reason: Chrome and WebKit agree exactly with the stacking-context isolation defined by Compositing 1 section 3.2 and CSS Transforms 2 section 7. The current Firefox capture omits the translated planes, so it cannot arbitrate their blending. Valle matches exactly; no pixel allowance.
